performance.verdict: ROAS collapse is real; 3-day purchases zero — not noise.

findings.text: ROAS fell 47.06% and purchases -55.56% WoW; last 3 days (Aug 22-24) show 0 purchases on $152.63 spend — confirmed collapse, not a single-day blip.
Live-Cooking Event Shoot 1 was due 2026-08-14 and has no completed event on record — fresh creative pipeline is stalled, directly worsening fatigue risk.
Creative fatigue probable: spend held ~$50-68/day throughout Aug while purchases went 6 (Aug 11) → 0 for 9 of last 11 days; no tracking or landing-page change logged.
GBP actions dropped 9.3% WoW and registered 0 for Aug 23-24; IG reach fell 19.54% — organic signals decelerating in parallel with paid, not offsetting it.
GA4 sessions rose 12.95% WoW (353 and 334 on Aug 23-24) while purchases were 0 — traffic arriving but not converting, suggesting a funnel or page issue.

suggestions.text: Inject new product creative into BWS - Sales - Muslims immediately; current assets produced 0 purchases across 9 of last 11 days.
suggestions.monday_update: The BWS - Sales - Muslims campaign ($834.95 / 28 days) has delivered 0 purchases in 9 of the last 11 days despite consistent ~$50-68/day spend, indicating creative exhaustion. Pull any new real-footage or approved stock-edit assets (facility footage delivered Jul 21 is available) and rotate them into the active ad set now. Success check: at least 2 purchases registered within 5 days of new creative going live (by 2026-08-30). Do not scale budget until the new creative shows a purchase signal.

suggestions.text: Escalate overdue Live-Cooking Shoot 1 (due Aug 14) to Video/Content lead; 11-day delay is directly blocking creative refresh pipeline.
suggestions.monday_update: The Live-Cooking Event Shoot 1 milestone, due 2026-08-14, has no completed event and is now 11 days overdue. With 0 purchases over the last 3 days and creative fatigue confirmed, this shoot is the primary unblocking asset for the refresh cycle. Nacer (Ops) to confirm a new delivery date with Video/Content by 2026-08-27. Success check: shoot footage delivered to the Ads board by 2026-08-29 so creative can be cut and launched before the next review cycle.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 session-to-purchase gap: sessions 353-334 on Aug 23-24, purchases 0 — re-check after new creative launches to isolate page vs. ad cause.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions hit 353 and 334 on Aug 23-24 while purchases were 0, suggesting the funnel may be breaking at the product or checkout page — not solely an ads problem. Do not make page changes yet; first let the new creative (S1) run 5 days to confirm whether the gap closes with fresher ads. If purchases remain 0 after new creative is live, escalate to a page/funnel audit by 2026-09-01. Reference the open /halal-subscribe conversion test (code ihbp8pmtn8) for additional context.
